content.title: The Masked Singer spoilers: Who is Crane?
content.text: Warning: this item includes The Masked Singer spoilers for Season 14 — read at your own risk! Crane soared into her wildcard debut on Jan. 21 with a powerhouse cover of Whitney Houston’s “It’s Not Right But It’s Okay.” While we initially leaned toward Mýa, we’ve officially changed our tune. After two weeks of clues (and a lot of back-and-forth), all signs now point to Normani.The résumé line alone — “primetime, film, billions of streams” — fits her perfectly. She rose to fame on The X Factor as a member of Fifth Harmony, one of the biggest girl groups of the 2010s, before launching a solo career that includes the multi-platinum hit “Love Lies.” In 2024, she starred in the action-comedy Freaky Tales. Billions of streams? Check. The dance clues are just as strong. Pink ballet slippers and that “center stage” confidence align with Normani’s elite performance background dating back to childhood competitions and pageants in Texas. The grandmother clue may be the biggest giveaway. Normani has frequently spoken about her beloved grandmother, Babs, who helped raise her and has appeared in viral TikTok and Instagram videos with the singer. Combine that with Normani’s childhood pageant days in Texas, and the Crane’s story about sewn gowns and grandma cheering from the front row fits seamlessly. Add in the Janet Jackson influence, Michelle Obama crossover and those Texas football hints, and the Crane’s journey lines up beat for beat. We’ve gone back and forth — but this time, the choreography fits. Gold Derby’s guess: NormaniNormaniPhoto : Amy Sussman/Getty ImagesNormani is a singer, dancer, and actress who first rose to fame on The X Factor as a member of Fifth Harmony. After the group went on hiatus, she launched a solo career with hits like “Love Lies” and “Motivation,” earning billions of streams and acclaim for her high-energy performances. In 2024, she expanded into film with a role in the action-comedy Freaky Tales.Crane Performance 1: “It’s Not Right But It’s Okay”The Crane on "Clueless Night" of 'The Masked Singer' Photo : Michael Becker/Fox Audio Clue: "It’s seamless for me to make my wildcard debut on “Clueless Night” because the '90s literally represent everything I do — and I do it all! Whether it’s primetime, film, or billions of streams — I’ve brushed wings with Janet [Jackson], Michelle [Obama] and even Angelina [Jolie] is a fan. But, I’ve had to work 10 times harder just to be seen. At times, yeah, my confidence was shattered. I spent many transformitave years taking control over my destiny. I’m proud to say, it’s my own wings that got me to climb this high, but I’m not done yet. Any chance I get to go for gold — I take it." Visual Clues: A sugar bowl, a diamond, origami birds, and a Christmas nutcracker. Onstage clue: Pink ballet slippers — she says, "I’m not the one to shy away from center stage." Panelist Guesses: Misty Copeland (Robin), Mya (Robin), Ashanti (Jenny) Crane Performance 2: “Say You’ll Be There”Crane on "Spice Girl Night" of 'The Masked Singer'Photo : Trae Patton/ FOX Audio Clue: "I feel lucky to have had an actual Spice Girl take me under her wing — Mel B. But, I've had an O.G. spice in my corner since before I could even walk — my grandma. I remember being five and seeing her dressed up as Tina Turner for Halloween — legs out, strutting like a diva. I guess that's where I got it from. She's literally like my second mom — sewing my costumes, making my evening gowns for pageants — in the front row at every performance. I could hear her voice screaming the loudest, 'That's my baby — do your thing, girl!' And now to spice up her life a little bit, Grandma, your baby's on your favorite show! I can't wait for you to figure out it's me under this mask all along, cuz' this Crane got it from her grandmother." Visual Clues: A photo of Mel B, a football helmet, a disco ball, a construction hat, makeup, and a tour bus. London clue: A train — she says, "Not every journey sparkles, but this one was pure gold for my soul." Panelist Guesses: Keke Palmer (Taraji), Ciara (Ken), and Mya (Robin). Crane Performance 3: “Good Luck, Babe!”Crane performance 3 on 'The Masked Singer'Photo : Trae Patton/ FOX Audio Clue: "I never thought I'd find myself in the bottom last time — and it made me realize how lucky I am to be here. But you've thrown out the same wrong name twice — so spoiler alert — I'm not Ashanti. Why don't you 'Care Bear stare' at my colossal clue." Colossal Care Bears Clue: A football player proposing to Crane. She said, "I just kicked off my next chapter with a major win. I couldn't be happier." Panelist Guesses: Taylor Swift (Ken), Normani (Rita and Jenny) Crane Performance 4: “Break Free”Crane on "Semi-Finals" episode of 'The Masked Singer.' Photo : Trae Patton/ FOX Audio Clue: "Tonight, if you really want to get to me, you'll need to open the case file and take a deeper look at my DNA. When I had my breakout success — we're talking multi-platinum — there was so much pressure to strike while the iron was hot. Behind closed doors, my world was falling apart. Both of my parents were sick. I had to be there for them. When I would share my work with them, I could see joy. I didn't realize it, but I was inspiring them to fight — and seeing their light pushed me to keep fighting too. We leaned on each other — and after several difficult years, we can finally take a deep breath. That's why I want to make it to the finale — they get so much joy watching me do my thing. I'm determined to show them the same strength they've shown me. Being a fighter is in my blood." Visual clues: A file showing Crane's brain and heart. Personal Connection Clue: Rita Ora.In her Q&A with Rita, we learned that Crane was not on a TV show Rita previously judged, they've never done a film together — but they were on TV together. It wasn't a talk show — they were competing. Panelist Guesses: Normani (Rita), SZA (Ken)
